context: M16 o8. Lisle's office, 11th floor. Marjorie brings papers. Lisle never touches them.

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: Nicholas. A bridge loan. From investors who admire you. Ninety days.

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: In exchange, a few more signatures. The hotels on Broadway. Routine.

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, your future. Sign where Marjorie marks.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I signed without reading. Like always. The secretary watched me do it.
